_comment: Per-wallet priority+bribe (validator tip) cost in USD PER LEG, address-keyed. Copy to wallet_fees.json (gitignored) and fill in real addresses and fees. These are the only costs not already embedded in PnL (DEX fee and slippage are inside the recorded trade amounts). net_pnl_usd = gross_pnl_usd - attributed buy/sell leg fees. For a wallet whose fee varies, use its blended average.
